spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (क्षायति)
To wane, to waste or decline.

n. (त्रं)
A multitude of fields, &c.
E.
क्षेत्र a field, &c. and अण् aff.

n. (-ज्ञ्यं)
Spirituality, the nature of the soul.
E.
क्षेत्रज्ञ, and अण् aff.

n. (-ज्ञ्यां)
Spirituality, the nature of the soul, the knowledge of it, &c.
E.
क्षेत्रज्ञ, and यञ् aff.

f. (-यी)
Milk and rice, or any preparation of milk.
E.
क्षीर milk, affix ढञ्, fem. affix ङीप्; some copies read this word क्षीरेयी.
